# di-text-015 You are working on a project for a market analysis firm. Your task is to identify the seasonal trends in the Superstore sales data. Based on your findings, select the most fitting description for each period from the following: "Generally stable trend", "Sharp downward trend", "Sales increase", "Sales drop", "Sales rise".
